limits: Triage only. The model ranks findings by how much they look like past candidates that survived triage. It does not verify anything.
Zero verified-real positives exist in the training data, so the model never predicts VERIFIED_REAL and must never be used to claim one. A high score means 'worth a live probe', nothing more.

Label skew: the training set is 85% worth-validating / 15% likely-false-positive (2246 positive / 399 negative of 2645 rows). Accuracy near the majority baseline means the model learned nothing; judge it by minority-class recall and ROC AUC instead.
Findings from plugins or chains unseen in training fall into the OTHER bucket; the model has no opinion about them beyond the generic features.

TDA coverage: 267 of 723 own rows carry a call-graph record, 7 with a non-empty graph (>0 callees or multihop edges). External rows carry no graph. A near-zero TDA delta on this data means the graphs are absent, not that topology cannot matter.
